thread:
alex: Quick FYI — noticing unexpected proration reversals on AWS Marketplace committed plans after we toggled the commitment window flag overnight. ~35 refunds showing up. Anyone else seeing this?

rachel: I see it. Payment feed has events flagged `proration_double_apply` when commitment_flag=true and promo_prorate also runs. Looks like two different codepaths applied a prorate credit.

matt: Can you grab a sanitized example?

rachel: Example: invoice 66789 | partner: orbitlabs | sku: RW-AWS-COMMIT | charge: 1200.00 | commitment_credit: -180.00 | promo_prorate: -180.00 | net: 840.00 — promo_prorate should not stack with commitment_credit.

sophie: Partner Support getting tickets. Pause settlements for impacted partners and flag top 10 by credit size.

alex: Finance approved manual corrections up to $6k while we fix. Rachel/matt, export CSV with invoice_id, partner_id, contact_email, extra_credit_usd. We'll rollback the flag and run a recompute for affected invoices.

ops-bot: Recompute job queued by matt; job-id rc_2028888888; ETA ~15m.

matt: Uploaded CSV to finance drive: https://drive.redwood/finance/aws-commit-prorate-2028888888.csv
notes: Root cause: commit-window flag caused two prorate codepaths to credit committed-plan customers twice. Impact: ~35 refunds, finance pre-approved up to $6k in emergency corrections. Actions: pause settlements, export partner CSV, rollback flag, run invoice recompute, notify partners with Partner Support and Partner Ops involvement.
